Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
This is your front-row ticket to seeing Hatsune Miku perform at your own game table. This electric bundle includes foil and non-foil versions of Secret Lair x Hatsune Miku: Sakura Superstar in English and Japanese.
Contents:
• 1x Secret Lair x Hatsune Miku: Sakura Superstar EN Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Hatsune Miku: Sakura Superstar JP Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Hatsune Miku: Sakura Superstar EN
• 1x Secret Lair x Hatsune Miku: Sakura Superstar JP
